title: Emberwall: "Bite-Sized" Grand Strategy + Tower Defense game
author: Thornwell
selftext:
AI generated reddit post included! 

Hey everyone,

I wanted to share a project I've been iterating on with AI called **Emberwall**.

The core hook I wanted to explore was: *What if you took the deeply satisfying macro-progression of a Grand Strategy game (managing a realm, expanding borders, diplomacy) and replaced the slow tactical battles with frantic, 3-minute arcade tower defense sequences?*

I wanted that "one more turn" addiction, but in a format that respects the player's time.

**The AI Workflow:** I used Claude Opus 5 to handle the heavy lifting of the custom HTML5/JS engine. The biggest challenge was transitioning the UI. It originally had a very chunky, "mobile game" vibe, and I worked extensively with Claude to overhaul the CSS and render pipeline to give it a dense, PC-focused, medieval aesthetic. Music and some art from Gemini. 

We also implemented a roguelite drafting system where you have to take "Faustian Bargains" between waves (huge buffs, but permanent curses) to survive the late-game sieges. All the atmospheric and combat music was prompted and generated using AI audio tools to fit a dynamic map/siege jukebox system.

**Play the Beta:** The game is completely playable in the browser right now on itch.io. I'm currently trying to balance the late-game economy (Waves 15-20), so I would absolutely love it if you guys could give it a spin and let me know how the game feels!

[DEMO](https://drthornwell.itch.io/emberwall)

Let me know if you have any questions about the prompts or architecture used to build the map rendering or the combat loop!
